Always read the governing edition and the project's special provisions before relying on a summary. Oilfield/mechanical/underground entries added 2026-10-15: official pages checked (OSHA and Texas statute pages read; ASME, API, AWS, AWWA, ASTM, LII and RRC pages returned HTTP 200; eCFR pages answer 200 to browsers but block automated readers; MSS blocks automated checks - confirmed via search index).

items.title: Scope of Work
items.summary: Contract intent; Art. 4 Changes in the Work (Engineer may change quantities/character of work; written change orders); Art. 5 Differing Site Conditions (notify before disturbing the condition); Art. 6 Requests for Additional Compensation and Damages (written notice required before the work); Art. 7 Dispute or Claims Procedure.
items.use: Cite Art. 4 for owner-directed changes, Art. 5 for unforeseen conditions, Art. 6 for the written-notice requirement on any extra-cost request.

items.title: Measurement and Payment
items.summary: Art. 1 Measurement of Quantities; Art. 2 Plans Quantity Measurement; Art. 3 Adjustment of Quantities; Art. 5 Progress Payments (monthly estimates); Art. 6 Payment for Material on Hand (MOH); Art. 7 Payment for Extra Work and Force Account Method (markups in 7.1); Art. 8 Retainage; Art. 9 Payment Provisions for Subcontractors; Art. 10 Final Payment.
items.use: Stored-material billing -> Art. 6 MOH; T&M/force account tickets -> Art. 7; subcontractor prompt pay -> Art. 9.

items.title: Excavation
items.summary: Roadway and channel excavation; measurement methods (final, original, vehicle) are set in the Item and the plans.
items.use: Check which measurement method the plans call for before carrying bank vs. loose CY.

items.title: Embankment
items.summary: Embankment types, placement and density control; measured as shown on the plans.
items.use: Fill quantities and compaction disputes.

items.title: Concrete Pavement
items.summary: Concrete pavement construction including reinforcing and joints.
items.use: Pavement reinforcing and dowel/tie bar quantities.

items.title: Excavation and Backfill for Structures
items.summary: Structure excavation, shoring, backfill and cement-stabilized backfill for structures.
items.use: Extra excavation or unsuitable material below structures.

items.title: Flowable Backfill
items.summary: Flowable backfill materials and placement.
items.use: Substitution of flowable fill for compacted backfill.

items.title: Drilled Shaft Foundations
items.summary: Drilled shaft construction, reinforcing cages, concrete placement; measured by the foot of shaft as shown.
items.use: Pier/shaft cage takeoff; overdrilled length as extra work.

items.title: Concrete Substructures
items.summary: Construction of concrete substructure elements (bents, caps, columns, abutments, etc.).
items.use: Concrete structure quantities; reinforcing is subsidiary per Item 440.

items.title: Hydraulic Cement Concrete
items.summary: Concrete materials, classes, mix design and testing for pavements and structures.
items.use: Concrete class/strength questions; concrete supplied by others on Rebar-Fab quotes.

items.title: Concrete Superstructures
items.summary: Bridge decks, slabs and other cast-in-place superstructure elements.
items.use: Deck reinforcing takeoff and pour sequencing.

items.title: Precast Concrete Structural Members (Fabrication)
items.summary: Fabrication requirements for precast structural members.
items.use: Precast vs. cast-in-place substitutions.

items.title: Riprap
items.summary: Concrete and stone riprap.
items.use: Riprap reinforcing (often welded wire or bars as shown).

items.title: Reinforcement for Concrete
items.summary: Materials (bar steel, epoxy coating, mechanical couplers), bending, placing, splicing and tying of reinforcement. Measurement and payment: not paid directly; subsidiary to the pertinent concrete Items.
items.use: Bar substitutions, lap lengths, coating repair. Because rebar is subsidiary, extra rebar is justified through the concrete Item or a change order under Item 4.

items.title: Steel Structures
items.summary: Fabrication and erection of structural steel.
items.use: Steel takeoff by weight.

items.title: Metal for Structures
items.summary: Material requirements for metals in structures.
items.use: Material grade questions.

items.title: Field Cleaning and Painting Steel
items.summary: Surface preparation and coating systems for steel.
items.use: Coatings takeoff and touch-up scope.

items.title: Structural Field Welding
items.summary: Field welding procedures, welder qualification and inspection.
items.use: Field weld extra work and qualification records.

items.title: Railing
items.summary: Concrete and metal bridge railing types.
items.use: Type C / T-series rail reinforcing.

items.title: Concrete Box Culverts and Drains
items.summary: Cast-in-place and precast box culverts.
items.use: Box culvert reinforcing per standard sheets.

items.title: Reinforced Concrete Pipe
items.summary: RCP furnishing and installation.
items.use: Pipe runs in LF.

items.title: Junction Boxes, Manholes, and Inlets
items.summary: Construction of drainage structures.
items.use: Inlet/manhole reinforcing counts.

items.title: Headwalls and Wingwalls
items.summary: Headwall and wingwall construction.

items.title: Removing Structures
items.summary: Removal and disposal of existing structures.

items.title: Concrete Curb, Gutter, and Combined Curb and Gutter
items.summary: Curb and gutter construction.
items.use: Curb LF and dowels.

items.title: Sidewalks

items.use: Sidewalk SF/rebar.

items.title: Conduit
items.summary: Conduit installation methods and types.
items.use: Conduit LF takeoff.

items.title: Electrical Conductors
items.summary: Conductor installation.
items.use: Wire LF.

items.title: Foundations for Traffic Control Devices
items.summary: Drilled foundations for signs and signals.
items.use: Sign/signal foundation cages.

items.title: Labor Standards for Contracts Involving Construction
items.summary: Construction Wage Rate Requirements (formerly Davis-Bacon) apply to federal construction contracts over $2,000; weekly certified payrolls (22.406-6); wage determinations (22.404); Copeland Act (22.403-2); CWHSSA overtime at 1.5x over 40 hrs (22.403-3).
items.use: Labor rates on federal T&M tickets must be at or above the wage determination; keep certified payroll backup.

items.title: Changes (construction clause)
items.summary: Contracting Officer may order changes in the work; contractor must assert its right to an adjustment in writing within the clause's time limit (see clause text).
items.use: Federal CO justification: cite the written order or constructive change and the notice date.

items.title: Differing Site Conditions
items.summary: Prompt written notice of subsurface/latent conditions differing from the contract, or unusual unknown conditions, before they are disturbed.
items.use: Unforeseen rock, water, utilities on federal work.

items.title: Prevailing wages on federally funded/assisted construction
items.summary: Laborers and mechanics on covered contracts over $2,000 must be paid at least the locally prevailing wages and fringes set by DOL; CWHSSA overtime applies to prime contracts over $100,000. Note the 2024 N.D. Tex. injunction on three provisions of the 2023 rule (see DOL page).
items.use: Check the wage determination on SAM.gov for the county and schedule (building/heavy/highway).

items.title: Labor standards provisions for federally financed and assisted construction
items.summary: Contract clauses, payroll and record requirements, withholding.
items.use: Certified payroll and withholding disputes.

items.title: Concrete Reinforcing
items.summary: DoD guide spec for reinforcing steel: submittals, materials, fabrication and placement. Project-edited versions govern.
items.use: USACE/NAVFAC/AF rebar submittals and placing tolerances.

items.title: Cast-in-Place Concrete
items.summary: DoD guide spec for cast-in-place concrete.
items.use: Federal concrete quality requirements.

items.title: Price and Payment Procedures
items.summary: DoD guide section for schedule of prices, payment and measurement procedures.
items.use: Federal pay application format and SOV backup.

items.title: Standard Specifications for Construction of Roads and Bridges on Federal Highway Projects
items.summary: Federal Lands Highway standard specs (2024 edition, errata updated 9/15/2026); Section 554 covers reinforcing steel and Section 552 structural concrete.
items.use: Federal Lands / Forest Service road and bridge work.

items.title: Application and Certificate for Payment / Continuation Sheet
items.summary: The common pay-app format. Right Hand Man produces a G702/G703-STYLE summary and continuation sheet; the official AIA forms are licensed - if a client requires the actual AIA document, fill that form with these numbers.
items.use: Client pay-app format.

items.title: General Provisions
items.summary: General conditions, measurement and payment, and change procedures for municipal public works (Division 100 amended in 2026).
items.use: Cite the general-provision article for changes/extra work; confirm the city's adoption and amendments (see NCTCOG adoption list).

items.title: Site Protection and Preparation
items.summary: Site preparation, protection and erosion control.
items.use: Clearing/erosion scope questions.

items.title: Roadway Construction
items.summary: Roadway paving including concrete pavement and its reinforcement (Division 300 amended in 2026).
items.use: Municipal paving rebar and concrete; pair with Std. Drawings Division 2000.

items.title: Underground Conduit Construction and Appurtenances
items.summary: Underground Conduit Construction and Appurtenances (water, wastewater, storm): pipe materials, embedment and backfill, appurtenances, boring/tunneling, testing. Standard drawings Div. 3000 General Underground Conduit, 4000 Water, 5000 Wastewater, 6000 Stormwater. 2026 amendments revise Items 500 and 501. Copyrighted - read your purchased copy for section text.
items.use: Pipe/trench extra depth or embedment changes.

items.title: Structures
items.summary: Concrete structures, reinforcing steel and related structural work for municipal projects.
items.use: Municipal structure rebar/concrete questions; check exact item numbers in the purchased edition.

items.title: Miscellaneous Construction and Materials
items.summary: Miscellaneous construction items and materials.
items.use: Material substitutions.

items.title: Welded Tanks for Oil Storage
items.summary: Design, materials, fabrication, erection, inspection and testing of welded, vertical, cylindrical, aboveground steel tanks (uniformly supported bottoms, non-refrigerated, design temperature up to about 200 °F). Tank sizes are chosen by the purchaser; the standard sets the rules, not a catalog of sizes.
items.use: Field-erected tank batteries and large storage tanks: cite for tank foundation tolerances, erection and hydrostatic testing called for in the tank spec. Many small production tanks are shop-built under API 12F instead - check the data sheet.

items.title: Shop Welded Tanks for Storage of Production Liquids
items.summary: Shop-fabricated, welded steel tanks of standard sizes for storing oil-field production liquids; listed in the API digital catalog.
items.use: Typical tank battery tanks are bought to 12F. Your scope is usually setting, foundations/ring walls, containment and connections - quantity tanks as EA from the plan/equipment list.

items.title: Welding of Pipelines and Related Facilities
items.summary: Gas and arc welding of butt, fillet and socket welds in carbon and low-alloy steel pipelines and related facilities (new construction and in-service), including procedure and welder qualification, NDT methods (RT, MT, PT, UT, visual) and acceptance standards.
items.use: Gathering lines/flowlines and pipeline tie-ins: weld count and NDE percentage come from the project spec; repairs/cut-outs from NDE rejects are a CO only when the cause is owner-side (e.g., owner-furnished pipe defects).

items.title: Planning, Designing and Constructing Fixed Offshore Platforms - Working Stress Design
items.summary: Recommended practice for fixed offshore steel platforms (planning, design, fabrication, installation). Listed in the API digital catalog.
items.use: Rare on land jobs; cited when a skid/structure spec borrows its tubular-joint or fabrication rules. Quantify steel by weight with the Structural steel template.

items.title: Line Pipe
items.summary: Seamless and welded steel line pipe (PSL 1 / PSL 2 product levels, grades such as B, X42-X70).
items.use: Steel gathering/flowline pipe callouts (size x wall x grade, PSL). Use the pipe size/schedule table for weight per foot; confirm wall from the line list.

items.title: Pipeline Transportation Systems for Liquids and Slurries
items.summary: Design, materials, construction, assembly, inspection, testing, operation and maintenance of liquid pipeline systems (crude, products, NGL, CO2, produced water and slurries) between production/terminal facilities.
items.use: Liquid gathering/transfer lines: hydrotest pressure, hold time and test records per the project spec referencing B31.4 (and 49 CFR 195 if PHMSA-regulated).

items.title: Gas Transmission and Distribution Piping Systems
items.summary: Gas transmission, gathering and distribution piping: design by location class, materials, welding, testing and operation.
items.use: Gas gathering lines and compressor station yard piping (outside B31.3 limits). Class location drives wall thickness and test pressure - from the design, never assumed.

items.title: Transportation of Natural and Other Gas by Pipeline
items.summary: Federal minimum safety standards for gas pipelines: design, materials, welding (Subpart E references API 1104 / ASME IX qualified procedures), construction, testing (Subpart J), operator qualification (Subpart N) and regulated gathering lines.
items.use: Regulated gas lines: welder qualification, test records and OQ for covered tasks are required paperwork; schedule time for them.

items.title: Transportation of Hazardous Liquids by Pipeline
items.summary: Federal minimum safety standards for hazardous-liquid and CO2 pipelines: design, construction, welding, pressure testing (Subpart E, e.g., §195.304 test pressure and duration), operation and maintenance.
items.use: Regulated liquid lines: carry test water, fill/heat-up, hold and documentation time; cite Subpart E when the owner changes test requirements.

items.title: Water Protection - pits now under 16 TAC Ch. 4
items.summary: Statewide Rule 8 protects surface and subsurface water from oil and gas waste. Effective July 1, 2025 the pit authorization/registration and waste management rules moved to new 16 TAC Chapter 4, Subchapter A (Schedule A and B authorized pits, registration deadlines in 2026; basic sediment and flare pits no longer authorized).
items.use: Pits, liners, containment and SWD facility work: confirm which Chapter 4 schedule/permit applies before quantifying liner and berm work; a permit-driven liner upgrade is a CO item.

items.title: Oil and Gas Waste Management (effective July 1, 2025)
items.summary: Subchapter A (new): oil and gas waste management, authorized pits, permits. Subchapter B (amended): commercial recycling - siting, minimum design and construction (e.g., liners, freeboard, run-on control, secondary containment for tanks) and financial security.
items.use: Recycling pits and commercial facilities: design/construction minimums come from the permit + Chapter 4; quantify liners, berms and containment from the permitted drawings.

items.title: Casing, Cementing, Drilling, Well Control and Completion
items.summary: Requirements for surface/intermediate/production casing, cementing, drilling and well control and completion to protect usable-quality water.
items.use: Mostly the operator/driller's scope; matters to pad builders for cellar, conductor and rig-move timing. Cite only if your contract work is affected by well-control requirements.

items.title: RRC oil and gas forms, permits and guidance
items.summary: Entry point for RRC oil and gas permits, forms, rules and guidance.
items.use: Look up permits for SWD wells, pits and recycling facilities referenced in the bid documents.

items.title: Process Safety Management of Highly Hazardous Chemicals
items.summary: Applies to processes at or above threshold quantities of listed chemicals, or 10,000 lb of flammable gas/liquid in one location (with exceptions; oil and gas well drilling/servicing and normally unoccupied remote facilities are excluded). Paragraph (h) sets contractor duties: train workers on process hazards and the emergency plan, document training, follow facility safe work practices, report hazards. Also hot work permits (k), management of change (l), pre-startup safety review (i).
items.use: Plants, gas processing, compressor stations with PSM coverage: price orientation/training time, hot-work permits and MOC waits; owner-caused permit delays are CO/standby time.

items.title: Oil Pollution Prevention - SPCC
items.summary: Facilities storing oil above thresholds need an SPCC plan; secondary containment for bulk storage containers must hold the largest container plus sufficient freeboard for precipitation.
items.use: Tank battery containment: the required capacity (largest tank + freeboard) comes from the SPCC plan/design. Use the Containment template to check the berm volume provided vs required.

items.title: Power Piping
items.summary: Piping for power plants, industrial plants, geothermal and central/district heating: design, materials, fabrication, erection, examination and testing (hydrostatic test generally at 1.5x design pressure - confirm against the edition and spec).
items.use: Boiler external piping, steam and condensate systems. Test pressure, NDE extent and PWHT come from the spec/line list.

items.title: Process Piping
items.summary: Piping in petroleum refineries, chemical, pharmaceutical, gas processing and related plants: fluid service categories (Normal, Category D, Category M, High Pressure), design, materials, fabrication, examination (random percentage by service) and leak testing (hydrostatic generally 1.5x design pressure adjusted for temperature - confirm against the edition).
items.use: Process/plant piping: fluid service drives NDE percentage and test method; a change in fluid service or test medium after bid is a CO.

items.title: Welding, Brazing and Fusing Qualifications
items.summary: Rules for qualifying welding/brazing/fusing procedures (WPS/PQR) and welder/operator performance; includes plastic (HDPE) fusing qualification.
items.use: Have qualified WPS/PQRs and welder continuity records before work; owner-required extra procedure qualifications are CO items.

items.title: Welded and Seamless Wrought Steel Pipe
items.summary: Standard dimensions (OD and wall thickness by schedule/weight class) for steel pipe. The app's pipe table uses common OD/wall values for Sch 40 and Sch 80; verify against the line list.
items.use: Pipe weight per foot = 10.69 x (OD - t) x t (carbon steel, lb/ft); hydrotest water volume from ID.

items.title: Structural Welding Code - Steel
items.summary: Welding of carbon and low-alloy structural steel: procedure and welder qualification, fabrication, inspection and acceptance criteria.
items.use: Pipe racks, skids, supports and platforms (structural welds), not pressure piping.

items.title: Pipe Hangers and Supports
items.summary: Materials, design, manufacture, selection, application and installation of pipe hangers and supports (incorporates former SP-69, SP-77, SP-89, SP-90). The 2025 edition is current. Site blocks automated checks; link verified via search index.
items.use: Support types and spacing: take spacing from the project spec/support drawings and enter it in the Pipe supports template; the app never assumes a spacing.

items.title: Specific Excavation Requirements
items.summary: Locate underground utilities before digging; means of egress in trenches 4 ft or deeper within 25 ft of lateral travel; hazardous atmosphere testing; water accumulation; spoil and equipment kept at least 2 ft back from the edge; daily inspections by a competent person.
items.use: Daily log trench fields (competent person, inspections) and CO backup for unmarked utilities / water.

items.title: Requirements for Protective Systems (sloping, shoring, shields)
items.summary: Cave-in protection is required unless the excavation is in stable rock or is under 5 ft deep with no indication of cave-in (competent person). Options: sloping/benching per Appendices A & B or tabulated data or PE design; shoring/shields per Appendices C/D, manufacturer's tabulated data, other tabulated data or PE design. Shields may sit up to 2 ft above the trench bottom only if rated for full depth and no soil loss.
items.use: Trench safety selector in Takeoff. Excavations over 20 ft deep need PE-designed systems.

items.title: Sloping and Benching (max allowable slopes)
items.summary: Maximum allowable slopes for excavations under 20 ft: stable rock vertical; Type A 3/4H:1V; Type B 1H:1V; Type C 1-1/2H:1V (with short-term and benching variations in the appendix). Soil type is classified per Appendix A by a competent person.
items.use: Sloped-trench excavation volume in the Trench template uses these slopes when no box is used.

items.title: Soil Classification
items.summary: How a competent person classifies soil as stable rock, Type A, B or C using visual and manual tests.
items.use: Soil type input for the trench selector; a geotech report differing from field conditions supports a DSC claim.

items.title: Trench Safety (Subchapter C)
items.summary: For trenches over 5 ft deep, bid documents and the contract must reference the OSHA trench standards, include any special shoring requirements, provide owner geotechnical info, and include a separate pay item for trench excavation safety protection paid by linear foot of trench (special shoring paid by square foot).
items.use: Make sure the SOV has a separate "Trench safety (LF)" line; missing pay item = RFI/CO.

items.title: Excavation and Backfill for Structures; Flowable Backfill; Trench Excavation Protection; Temporary Special Shoring
items.summary: Item 400 structure excavation and backfill (measured within boundaries, no pay for swell or cave-ins); Item 401 flowable backfill by CY placed; Item 402 trench excavation protection measured by the foot along the trench where depth exceeds 5 ft (includes trench ends); Item 403 temporary special shoring by SF of the vertical face.
items.use: TxDOT utility/drainage work: carry trench protection LF only where depth > 5 ft; shoring SF separately.

items.title: Pipe culverts, box culverts, RCP, junction boxes/manholes/inlets, headwalls, SETs, thermoplastic pipe
items.summary: Item 460 Corrugated Metal Pipe; 462 Concrete Box Culverts and Drains; 464 Reinforced Concrete Pipe; 465 Junction Boxes, Manholes and Inlets; 466 Headwalls and Wingwalls; 467 Safety End Treatment; 468 Thermoplastic Pipe Culverts and Drains (2024 book).
items.use: Storm takeoff: pipe by size/class in LF, structures EA; cite the Item for measurement rules.

items.title: Installation of Ductile-Iron Water Mains and Their Appurtenances
items.summary: Installation of DI water mains: handling, trenching, bedding, laying, joint assembly, thrust restraint, backfill, hydrostatic pressure and leakage testing (allowable leakage formula in the standard).
items.use: Water main testing time and allowable leakage - use the project spec values.

items.title: PVC Pressure Pipe and Fabricated Fittings, 4 in. through 60 in.
items.summary: PVC pressure pipe for water/wastewater/reclaimed water by DR and pressure class.
items.use: Pipe takeoff by size and DR; installation per the spec (often AWWA C605 for PVC).

items.title: Ductile-Iron Pipe, Centrifugally Cast
items.summary: Manufacture of DI pipe 3-64 in. for water, wastewater and reclaimed water, push-on or MJ joints.
items.use: DI pipe takeoff by size and pressure class; lining/coating from spec.

items.title: Underground Installation of Thermoplastic Pipe (gravity)
items.summary: Installation practice for flexible thermoplastic gravity pipe: embedment material classes, bedding, haunching and initial backfill zones, compaction, and deflection testing guidance.
items.use: Embedment quantities: zone dimensions come from the project detail; the app asks for bedding depth and cover above crown - it never assumes them.

items.title: Type PSM PVC Sewer Pipe and Fittings
items.summary: PVC gravity sewer pipe and fittings (commonly 4-15 in.), SDR 35 / SDR 26.
items.use: Sanitary pipe by size and SDR; mandrel testing per spec/TCEQ.

items.title: PVC Large-Diameter Plastic Gravity Sewer Pipe and Fittings
items.summary: Large-diameter PVC gravity sewer pipe (18 in. and larger).
items.use: Large sanitary trunk lines by size and wall class.

items.title: Design Criteria for Domestic Wastewater Systems
items.summary: Texas design and construction criteria for collection systems and treatment: pipe materials, embedment, manholes, testing of gravity lines (low-pressure air or infiltration/exfiltration, deflection/mandrel) and manhole testing, water/wastewater separation.
items.use: Sanitary testing items (air, mandrel, manhole vacuum) and CCTV; cite when the owner adds tests beyond the contract.

items.title: Public Drinking Water
items.summary: Rules for public water systems, including distribution design and construction, separation distances from wastewater lines, disinfection and bacteriological sampling before placing mains in service.
items.use: Water main disinfection/bac-T time and separation conflicts (RFI/CO when plans violate separation).
